content.en_US:
The irradiation channel allows an [[RBMK]] to bomard items with neutrons, performing certain recipes. It has to be placed such that a [[fuel channels|RBMK Fuel Channel]] provides the necessary neutron flux. If the irradiation channel is empty, it becomes transparent to neutrons. Higher reactivity reactors will process recipes faster.

Irradiation channels can be used as the earliest way of obtaining [[high-performance solvent|High-Performance Solvent]] or as a reliable way of making [[tritium|Tritium]], as well as certain other recipes. All irradiation channel recipes can also be performed by the [[fusion reactor breeding chamber|Fusion Reactor Breeding Chamber]].
